title: Finite Q3 split Gibbs/KMS source-uniformity stress
question: When the source site of the local q/p-character pair is moved through every site of the finite path4/path6 Q3 graphs, do the Gibbs stationarity and analytic KMS residuals retain the finite mesh-decrease pattern for both split orders, signs and beta values?

model.observable_pair: A_x=exp(i a q_x/hbar), B_x=exp(i a p_x/hbar) at each source site x
model.gibbs_state: rho_beta=exp(-beta H)/Tr(exp(-beta H)) for the same finite Q3 H
model.kms_boundary: R_x=Tr(rho A_x alpha^S_t(B_x))-Tr(rho alpha^S_{t+i beta hbar}(B_x) A_x)
model.source_scope: All sites in each declared path graph; no source-uniform limit is inferred from the finite range.

adversarial_review.check: Every declared site in path4 and path6 is tested; source variation is reported instead of replacing the graph by a translation-invariant torus.
The alpha convention uses t+i beta hbar and the same convention is applied at every source site and both time signs.
Complex split products use reverse factor order and -z for the inverse; no complex adjoint shortcut is used.
Only the nondegenerate d=3 fixture is admitted and a positive [H,H_onsite] witness is checked for each graph.
Coarse/fine decreases are checked per source context but are not promoted to a uniform analytic rate.
Path4/path6 is a structured finite exhaustion pair; source-wise similarity does not prove arbitrary-shape exhaustion independence.
The independent lane rebuilds all tensor matrices and residuals without importing the primary script.
Lean R247 checks finite Gibbs normalization/commutation and conditional-transfer scope; Python carries dense source-wise Q3 rows.
Source-wise finite residuals do not prove source-uniform common-core Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

lean_crosscheck.role: R247 checks exact rational finite Gibbs normalization/commutation; Python checks source-wise noncommuting Q3 residuals.

qft_interface.closed: The exact finite-H Gibbs controls and source-wise split stationarity/KMS residuals are reproduced over all declared sites, orders, signs, beta values and two meshes.
qft_interface.open: Source-uniform analytic rate, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, common unbounded core, all-shape exhaustion independence, one common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS/KMS quotient, gap, continuum and physical TECT gates remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6/Q3 finite evidence only; no heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner, physical-empty reference, Sector-A closure or Pre-A closure is supplied.

next_action: Use the source-wise residual range to choose a source-uniform weighted core estimate; if boundary/interior constants diverge under volume or cutoff, record that route-local obstruction before common-alpha promotion.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite d=3 source-wise Q3 KMS diagnostic. It is not a thermodynamic-limit source-uniformity theorem, common-alpha construction, or QFT/Clay result.
no_overclaim: All-site finite residuals and their mesh decrease do not identify a common thermodynamic Q3 dynamics or close OS/KMS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A gates.
